{{Quotation|game|By longstanding tradition, full-scale arena combat is prohibited on the rural island of [[Shing Jea Island|Shing Jea]], out of reverence for the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]] of the same name. Yet those who study at the monastery require a place to train in such arts. The solution? Shing Jea Arena, located on the tiny island of Tinnairukan south of the larger landmass... close enough to train, but separated from Shing Jea Island itself.}}

[[Shing Jea Arena (outpost)|Shing Jea Arena]] is the staging area for [[Player versus Player|PvP]] combat for characters of [[level]]s 1 to 10.

==Getting there==
Talk to [[Bauyun]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]].

==Notes==
*Complete exploration of this outpost contributes approximately 0.3% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. The arena itself also contributes to the title almost as much as the outpost. An alternate version of the arena is accessible during the last quest of the Winds of Change, [[The Final Confrontation]].

==Trivia==
{{gw2w|Isle of Reflection}}
*In ''Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons'', the island is called "Isle of Reflection".
*There is a large pot in a corner that spews out patterns in the smoke. Most of those patterns are Chinese characters.
*There is a dog (cannot be selected) standing right outside the locked gate. That dog appears to be a [[W:Pug|pug]], a possible play on the [[PUG]] acronym.
